title: Nasdaq-100 annual reconstitution announced after the close — the once-a-year NDX membership list, plus that quarter's NDX rebalance, both effective at the 2027-12-20 open
source: EST: date derived by applying the index owner's own published methodology to the 2027 calendar, RE-FETCHED AND RE-EXTRACTED THIS SESSION rather than inherited from either proposal. indexes.nasdaqomx.com/docs/methodology_NDX.pdf, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 422,314 bytes — the same byte count both proposals recorded; 29 Flate streams inflated and the text layer re-extracted in-session), carries two schedules in one table: 'Reconstitution Frequency: Annually ... Reconstitution Reference Dates: Last trading day of November ... Reconstitution Announcement Dates: After the close on the sixth trading day prior to the Reconstitution Effective Date ... Reconstitution Effective Dates: At market open on the first trading day following the third Friday in December' AND 'Rebalance Frequency: Quarterly ... Rebalance Announcement Dates: After the close on the sixth trading day prior to the Rebalance Effective Date ... Rebalance Effective Dates: At market open on the first trading day following the third Friday in March, June, September, and December' — so in December one announcement carries both, a point the 2026 sibling proposal named first and this session re-read independently. Applied to 2027: December's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st, so the third Friday is 2027-12-17 (independently `confirmed` on OCC's own 2027 calendar by opex-2027-12-17), the effective date is MONDAY 2027-12-20, and counting back six trading sessions gives 12-17 (1), 12-16 (2), 12-15 (3), 12-14 (4), 12-13 (5), 12-10 (6) — the announcement lands after the close on FRIDAY 2027-12-10. No US market holiday falls inside that span (Christmas Day 2027-12-25 is a Saturday, observed Friday 2027-12-24, after the whole window), so no session is displaced. THE COROLLARY THE PROPOSALS DID NOT STATE, AND THE STRONGEST EVIDENCE THIS ENTRY HAS: because there is never a holiday between the second and third Fridays of December, the six-session count back always lands exactly on the SECOND FRIDAY OF DECEMBER — verified mechanically for all 21 cycles 2005-2025, 21 of 21. And the effective-date half of the rule was validated against OBSERVED history, not just arithmetic: the annual add/remove table on Wikipedia's 'Historical components of the Nasdaq-100' (fetched direct 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 63,555 bytes; a SECONDARY source, labelled as such) carries a December reconstitution block for every year 2007-2025, and its 19 dates match the 19 effective dates this rule computes — 19 of 19, zero misses. Stays `estimate` on two counts, not three: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published methodology (the same gap every S&P DJI and Russell entry records), and Nasdaq's 2027 release does not exist yet. The proposals' third count — 'a forward application of a standing rule rather than a fetched schedule' — is retired: the rule now has a 19-of-19 out-of-sample record against observed reconstitutions. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), after reading the one proposal for this id in full: proposals/ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2027-12-10.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20.json. This is the calendar's FIRST canonical Nasdaq-100 milestone in any year; the only other NDX entry is proposals/ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2026-12-11.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-12-21.json, a sibling lane's proposal for the nearer cycle, which stands. THE QUESTION BOTH PROPOSALS LEFT OPEN IS NOW ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER IS MOSTLY A NULL. Both said in capitals that whether the NDX announcement moves NDX constituents the way the S&P announcement moves S&P ones is 'precisely the untested question' needing 'a constituent-level instrument this house does not own'. This session built one: 19 reconstitution cohorts 2007-2025 from the Wikipedia change table (237 named rows; 11 dropped by an automated ticker-reuse guard comparing the table's security name against Yahoo's longName, 66 with no usable bars — 88 of 117 additions and 78 of 120 removals usable, attrition concentrated on later-acquired removals), measured against QQQ on the session after each after-close announcement. THE ADDITION LEG IS A NULL IN EVERY ERA AND ON BOTH BENCHMARKS: 48 of 85 positive, sign p=27.8%, mean -0.007%, Mann-Whitney against a 1,785-row same-window baseline p=75.6%; and 0 of 19 cycle means reached the +2.31% directional excess the S&P panel measured, the highest being +1.36%. THE REMOVAL LEG IS REAL POOLED AND DEAD IN THE MODERN ERA: -0.579% mean / -0.575% median excess, 49 of 75 negative, sign p=1.1%, MW against a 1,569-row baseline of the SAME names on other sessions in the SAME December window p=0.5% (so it is not tax-loss selling or momentum), robust to a size-closer benchmark (-0.448% vs the Nasdaq Composite, 48/75, p=2.0%) and to treating each cycle as one observation (14 of 19, p=6.4%) — but 2007-2015 runs -0.994% (24/32, p=0.7%, MW p=0.2%) against 2016-2025 at -0.271% (25/43, p=36.0%, MW p=23.4%) and 2019-2025 at -0.235% (19/35, p=73.6%, MW p=43.6%). That is Greenwood & Sammon's decaying index effect, confirmed within one family across 19 cycles instead of one. WHAT IS NOT DEAD IS TURNOVER, AND IT IS NOT ON THIS DATE: the named cohort's median relative turnover is 0.996x/1.092x on the announcement session itself, steps to 1.268x/1.243x on the reaction session, and reaches 4.900x (adds) / 4.773x (removes) on the IMPLEMENTATION Friday 2027-12-17 — 85 of 85 and 74 of 75 above 1.0x — while QQQ prints 1.295x and SPY 1.877x on that same session. The flow is enormous in the names and nearly invisible in the vehicle. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: any membership names, which will not exist until Nasdaq publishes after the 2027-12-10 close; that the removal effect is tradeable, since the implied position is short, the house-wide short ban blocks it, the move does not extend (reaction-open-to-effective-close is a null on both legs, p=51.5% and p=90.8%), and no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped 2026-09-09 for rebalanc|index effect|index inclusion|reconstitut|deletion|witching|closing auction, zero hits in both); and any index-level footprint on this session, which was measured and is absent. Low impact and market-structure only; estimate; nothing here licenses an entry. Ledger: docs/research/events/ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2027-12-10.md
